title: Autumn Pampkin
author: Art Garden
description:
This set is about charm and wilting and about mood and breath of autumn.
Autumn items, leaves and dried branches of trees and flowers , vintage dishes, candles and bakery products.
Autumn floral clipart. Retro decor. Fall leaves clipart.
Collection of hand drawn elements, seamless patterns, wreaths and arrangements by colored pencils.
The compositions are complemented by abstract stainss and background made with colored pencils.
The set is perfect for elegant autumn wedding design, for thanksgiving cards, textile design, fall posters, farmhouse decorations. Ideal for Halloween prints.
Also for eco menu template, menu card, restaurant decor, packaging, price tags, banner, invitation, label, tags, restaurant wall art, food poster.  party decor or logo design.  
THIS LARGE COLLECTION INCLUDES:
44 PNG separate files with elements (300 dpi, RGB, transparent background)
28 PNG separate files with creative arrangements (300 dpi, RGB, transparent background)
15 PNG file with ready for use corners and wreaths (300 dpi, RGB, transparent background)
4 PNG file with creative backgrounds made in the technique of colored pencils (300 dpi, RGB, transparent background)
12 PNG and JPEG files with seamless patterns
3 abstract spots made in the technique of colored pencils (300 dpi, RGB, transparent background)
You can use them in Illustrator and Photoshop.
